total_supply_before_empty.meaning: gauge _totalSupply after users withdraw all staked tokens, before the empty accrual period

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: a period of time passed with no deposits while total supply was zero

notify_reward_called_during_empty.meaning: distribution contract called notifyRewardAmount to add rewards during the empty period

full_epoch_emissions_unclaimable.meaning: the full epoch's emissions (one week reward duration) remain permanently unclaimable after the gauge was empty for the entire reward duration

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount is attributed to the distribution contract, not an unauthorized caller.
The empty period spans an entire reward duration of one week.
Reward tokens were transferred to the gauge for the epoch.

unresolved.description: Report states notifyRewardAmount 'may be called' during the empty period; whether rewards were actually added in the incident is not established.
Report gives no exact reward amounts or token values for the stuck epoch.

limitations: Formalizes only the full-epoch-stuck impact; other impacts are handled separately.
The one-week reward duration is treated as the epoch scope qualifier, not a numeric bound predicate.
Claimability is represented as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric claimable-amount definition.
